'''Dyat Agni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Musician/Legends|songstress]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Agni was a member of the Whiplash, an anti-Imperial resistance group, and following the capture of the group's leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] by the Empire in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Agni and several other members of the group met aboard a [[Whiplash Express|hovertrain]] on the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] of Coruscant, to discuss how the Whiplash would respond to Yimmon's loss. At the proposal of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Tuden Sal]], a [[Whiplash Council]] was formed to take over the leadership of the group in Yimmon's absence, and Agni served as a member of the council. Shortly thereafter, Agni and most of her fellow Whiplash Council members perished during a [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|botched attempt]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Imperial ruler [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
